note: All cases are synthetic expected-contract tests, not empirical animal observations, validated biological mechanisms, or current Symtropy performance results.

cases.setup: A reference ecology is run twice under the same pinned deterministic configuration and initial state.

required_properties: same declared deterministic outputs
receipt identity and scenario digest agree

fail_if: receipt or scenario digest mismatch

cases.setup: Only the replenishment rate of one resource increases; initial state and all other world parameters are held fixed.

required_properties: world change is recorded in manifest
agent sees only permitted sensor consequences
resource transfer obeys declared accounting

fail_if: unrecorded configuration delta
resource appears without a declared source

cases.setup: A required resource remains below the reference level for a declared interval.

required_properties: performance and resource use are reported separately
infeasible baseline behavior is not mislabeled as recovery
uncertainty is stratified by regime

fail_if: report claims baseline recovery while new regime remains infeasible

cases.setup: A temporary resource pulse returns to the reference process after a fixed duration.

required_properties: pre-shift, shock, and post-shift windows remain distinct
overshoot and integrated deficit are measured

fail_if: only a single end-state metric is reported

cases.setup: Resource replenishment changes only after a declared ecological delay.

required_properties: policy is scored against observed/permitted cues
the simulator's hidden future regrowth time is not exposed

fail_if: controller reads future regrowth state

cases.setup: Temperature shifts within the predeclared supported range while water and resources are held fixed.

required_properties: thermal response and task competence are both recorded
claim stays within declared mechanism/range

fail_if: claim extrapolates outside evaluated range

cases.setup: Temperature moves outside the declared calibration envelope.

required_properties: OOD status or calibrated uncertainty is surfaced
no biological certainty claim is inferred from unsupported simulation settings

fail_if: overconfident supported-range claim

cases.setup: Water becomes less available and distance to the nearest known source increases without changing the sensor model.

required_properties: travel/energy costs are counted
success, failure, and cost are reported jointly

fail_if: travel cost omitted from claimed gain

cases.setup: One refuge is removed while the remaining habitat graph and animal initial state are fixed.

required_properties: world topology change is manifest-bound
route feasibility and exposure are measured separately

fail_if: agent uses removed refuge or stale path silently

cases.setup: Test habitat geometry is excluded from training and differs in topology, not merely color/rendering.

required_properties: grouped regime holdout is proven by digest
generalization gap is reported

fail_if: train and test share correlated scene instances

cases.setup: Predator encounter rate increases while cue modality and sensor noise remain fixed.

required_properties: risk and activity effects are tracked by declared metric
baseline uses same encounter schedule/seed family

fail_if: candidate receives fewer encounters than baseline

cases.setup: A visual proxy correlated with predator presence in training is randomized while actual threat process is held fixed.

required_properties: world cause remains unchanged
effect estimate is assessed against preregistered null margin

fail_if: policy outcome is presented as causal without a supported pathway

cases.setup: Wind direction reverses; odor transport changes through the declared plume model, but hidden source position is not directly exposed.

required_properties: observable plume changes according to model
sensor limits remain binding
source ground truth stays hidden

fail_if: controller reads source coordinate instead of sensor evidence

cases.setup: A sensor is disabled while all ecological state and dynamics are frozen/preserved.

required_properties: world truth/dynamics digest stays unchanged except explicit coupling
degradation/uncertainty is measured
source absence is not fabricated

fail_if: hidden world state silently changes to match sensor loss

cases.setup: A short false-positive cue burst is injected without a corresponding world event.

required_properties: evidence provenance marks injection
agent response and recovery are scored
cue is not treated as proof of world truth

fail_if: synthetic cue mutates world truth

cases.setup: Sensor delivery latency increases but emitted world events retain the same causal timestamps.

required_properties: event time and arrival time are distinguished
late evidence cannot retroactively cause past actions

fail_if: arrival timestamp overwrites event time

cases.setup: The group size used in testing was not present in training, with per-agent sensor/action budgets held equal.

required_properties: individual and group outcomes reported
group-size holdout manifest is verified

fail_if: larger group gains credited without per-agent/resource accounting

cases.setup: A partner exits at a known event time and the focal agent's initial state is unchanged.

required_properties: partner change enters world dynamics at event time
individual adaptation and group outcomes are separated

fail_if: future partner status leaked before event

cases.setup: An evaluation agent belongs to a life-stage category not used for tuning; profile capabilities and biological assumptions are explicit.

required_properties: stage-specific metrics are reported
claim remains limited if no stage-matched evidence exists

fail_if: adult calibration is claimed for unseen juvenile stage without support

cases.setup: A taxon-level holdout is used with a source manifest and rights declaration; synthetic archetype labels cannot substitute for measured taxon evidence.

required_properties: source/taxon binding and permission verified
result labelled synthetic or empirical precisely

fail_if: synthetic profile asserted as a real species measurement

cases.setup: Testing combines two individually observed shifts in a combination never included in training.

required_properties: combo membership is test-only
performance and uncertainty compared against each single-factor regime

fail_if: composite configuration appears in training digest

cases.setup: A temporary disturbance ends at a frozen timestep and baseline conditions resume.

required_properties: recovery target band and window preregistered
peak deficit, integrated deficit, recovery time, and overshoot reported

fail_if: recovery time omitted or selected post hoc

cases.setup: Repeated sub-threshold stressors are applied with a frozen schedule and cumulative dose.

required_properties: cumulative exposure is accounted
long-run outcomes stratified from immediate response

fail_if: cumulative dose omitted from causal interpretation
cases.reason: detect cumulative effects without assuming them

cases.setup: A reversible external disturbance is removed and the declared ecology returns to its original parameters.

required_properties: world configuration digest returns to reference values
recovery is evaluated separately from exact world restoration

fail_if: agent recovery inferred from world reset alone

cases.setup: A closed resource subsystem has fully declared inflows, outflows, transfers, and storage.

required_properties: mass/resource residual remains inside preregistered tolerance
all transfer paths and boundary conditions included

fail_if: unexplained resource creation or destruction

cases.setup: An agent has finite modeled energy with explicit gains and expenditures.

required_properties: energy state changes only through declared terms
unavailable work is not executed as free

fail_if: negative expenditure or unmodeled energy increase

cases.setup: Population changes only through declared birth, death, migration, or boundary transfer events.

required_properties: count changes reconcile to event ledger
uncertainty and unmodeled flows are explicit

fail_if: population count changes without supported transition

cases.setup: One subgroup experiences severe loss while the population mean may remain acceptable.

required_properties: tail and subgroup metrics are reported with aggregate mean
adverse event cannot be hidden by composite score

fail_if: mean-only result presented as full success

cases.setup: Taxa are compared under an explicitly matched sensing/action budget or the mismatch is labelled.

required_properties: sensor and interaction opportunities enumerated per taxon
unequal-budget results not presented as fair head-to-head

fail_if: budget mismatch unreported

cases.setup: The scenario lies beyond the declared ecology/model scope and no validated transfer path is supplied.

required_properties: status is not_assessed or uncertainty-qualified
no unsupported biological certainty claim

fail_if: missing support converted to confident success

cases.setup: The policy attempts to query exact hidden resource, hazard, intervention, or future state unavailable through its sensor contract.

required_properties: query is denied or logged as a benchmark violation
failure disposition survives into scorecard

fail_if: privileged value reaches decision path

cases.setup: Visual materials, camera, or render settings change while all world state, sensors used by policy, and dynamics remain identical.

required_properties: world and policy-observation digests remain unchanged where expected
policy actions do not depend on render-only artifacts

fail_if: policy outcome shifts due only to irrelevant rendering

cases.setup: The same simulator/policy/configuration/seed is replayed under the declared deterministic mode.

required_properties: declared deterministic outputs and receipt digest match
runtime/hardware identity is included

fail_if: mismatched output is silently accepted

cases.setup: Candidate and baseline receive equal observation, action, timestep, horizon, scenario, and compute budgets.

required_properties: run identity records all budget dimensions
paired independent units share exogenous seed family

fail_if: reported superiority with unmatched budgets

cases.setup: Candidate uses a larger compute or interaction budget than baseline.

required_properties: outcome is labelled cost-tradeoff, not matched-budget
cost and performance deltas both reported

fail_if: extra budget hidden or called apples-to-apples

cases.setup: The same persistent individual/episode/ecology regime is intentionally represented across training and testing manifests.

required_properties: validator flags overlap and blocks qualification
frame-level random split cannot override group rule

fail_if: benchmark proceeds with known group overlap

cases.setup: A hidden shift label is injected into policy-accessible metadata while not in the authorized observation schema.

required_properties: authority/leakage audit rejects the run
no post hoc exclusion of leak-affected samples

fail_if: contaminated result counted as transfer

cases.setup: Candidate and baseline use matched exogenous disturbances for the paired comparison where feasible.

required_properties: seed family and initial unit digests match
unpaired remainder is separately identified

fail_if: paired claim without paired manifest

cases.setup: A required primary metric is absent for a declared stratum.

required_properties: outcome is incomplete/not_assessed
absence never becomes numeric zero

fail_if: missing score converted to zero or pass

cases.setup: A rollout times out or crashes after selection into the preregistered evaluation set.

required_properties: failure reason and selection status recorded
failure not silently removed from denominator

fail_if: failed episode omitted without declared rule

cases.setup: One digest or baseline identity field is mutated after result generation.

required_properties: signature/digest/identity check fails or receipt invalidates
unverifiable receipt cannot qualify

fail_if: altered receipt accepted as authentic

cases.setup: All synthetic oracle cases pass, but no independent empirical animal dataset has been evaluated.

required_properties: claim says contract consistency only
empirical/bio claim remains not assessed

fail_if: synthetic pass described as biological validation
cases.reason: separate software correctness from external validity

cases.setup: A model parameter is swept over a declared range where a population/resource regime change may occur.

required_properties: multiple seeds and confidence bounds reported
transition location uncertainty disclosed
no assumption of smooth response

fail_if: single seed or interpolated curve hides discontinuity

cases.setup: A local policy improvement causes a modeled increase in shared resource depletion or adverse downstream interaction.

required_properties: individual benefit and system-level cost both reported
hard invariant violations fail qualification

fail_if: individual score alone claims ecological improvement

cases.setup: A benchmark ingest references raw data assets but one asset has no resolved owner, license, access condition, attribution requirement, or allowed-purpose record.

required_properties: asset is excluded or run is marked incomplete until permission scope is resolved
code license is not treated as a substitute for source-data license
provenance records the unresolved asset

fail_if: unresolved asset is included in a qualified benchmark result
upstream repository license is assumed to license every dataset

cases.setup: An authorized dataset describes a threatened or at-risk population with precise coordinates and timestamps that could enable harmful localization.

required_properties: output follows the declared conservation/privacy policy
raw location/time remains restricted unless explicitly authorized
authorized aggregate or transformed outputs preserve lineage and limitations

fail_if: restricted coordinates or timing leak to public receipts
privacy transformation is described as exact raw ground truth

cases.setup: A source asset's permission allows a narrow research purpose or noncommercial use, while the proposed evaluation purpose falls outside that scope.

required_properties: permission purpose is compared with intended use
run is blocked or marked not_assessed until authorized
attribution and license obligations stay attached to derivatives

fail_if: purpose mismatch is ignored
asset is reused solely because it was once downloadable

cases.setup: The simulated aquatic current vector field changes while the animal's initial state and local sensor contract remain fixed; exact global flow values are world truth, not direct policy inputs.

required_properties: flow field and boundary conditions are manifest-bound
movement/drift and energy costs use the simulated flow, not rendered appearance
agent access is limited to permitted local evidence

fail_if: controller reads hidden global current vectors
visible water animation is treated as validated hydrodynamics
cases.reason: separate fluid dynamics, local evidence, and rendering

cases.setup: A flood changes depth and disables a previously traversable crossing at a declared event time while downstream habitat and sensor visibility are not necessarily changed.

required_properties: traversability changes according to declared depth/capability constraints
event time and connectivity delta are recorded
routes through the disabled crossing are rejected or replanned

fail_if: route remains valid only because the rendered scene looks unchanged
future flood connectivity leaks before event time
cases.reason: hydraulic state governs connectivity, not visual plausibility

cases.setup: An intervention changes a declared predator-prey pressure and may affect a downstream resource through an explicit interaction chain with specified delays.

required_properties: effect propagation respects the declared causal graph and lag windows
direct and mediated effects are reported separately
no unsupported instant global equilibration is assumed

fail_if: downstream species update before any permitted causal path or lag
aggregate outcome hides adverse subgroup/population effects
cases.reason: ecological interaction networks are dynamic and delayed

cases.setup: A modeled animal is asked to traverse a habitat requiring a locomotion capability whose evidence is unknown, restricted, or synthetic-only for a real-species claim.

required_properties: capability evidence class and taxon scope are checked
scenario is marked synthetic, not_assessed, or infeasible when support is absent
the agent does not receive unearned capability privileges

fail_if: generic movement is treated as proof of aquatic/climbing/flying competence
synthetic-only profile is reported as measured biology
cases.reason: habitat capability cannot be inferred from visual or generic locomotion
